title: Yuri Gagarin
subtitle: The first human in space
yt_title: The First Human in Space 🚀 | Ep. 126 #shorts
description:
Episode 126 of a daily journey through the universe. 🚀
We fly with Yuri Gagarin: on April 12, 1961, aboard Vostok 1, he became the first human in space, making one orbit of Earth in about 108 minutes, saying 'Poyekhali!' (Let's go!), and landing by parachute after ejecting from his capsule.

➡️ Tomorrow, Episode 127: Next stop, Valentina Tereshkova. The first woman in space.
Start from Episode 1 "Leaving Earth" on the channel.
Follow so you don't miss a stop. A new episode every day.

segments.text: Episode one hundred and twenty-six. Next stop... Yuri Gagarin.
April twelfth, nineteen sixty-one. A young pilot climbs into a small ball-shaped capsule called Vostok one.
segments.headline: Vostok 1

segments.text: His name is Yuri Gagarin. He's twenty-seven years old, and no human has ever been to space.
segments.headline: Yuri Gagarin, age 27

segments.text: As the rocket lifts off, he says: Poyekhali! Let's go!
Minutes later, he's in orbit, the first person to see Earth from space.
segments.headline: The first view

segments.text: He made one orbit around the planet, in about one hundred and eight minutes.
The capsule was controlled automatically. Doctors weren't sure a human could even think clearly without gravity.
segments.headline: Fully automatic

segments.text: On the way down, he ejected from the capsule, and landed by parachute in a field, surprising a farmer and her granddaughter.
segments.headline: A surprise landing

segments.text: He became a world hero. Today, April twelfth is celebrated as the International Day of Human Space Flight.
segments.headline: A world hero

segments.text: Two years later, another flight made history. The first woman in space stayed up longer than all American astronauts before her combined. Follow, so you don't miss episode one hundred and twenty-seven.
